`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 64 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 6 && W == 64) begin : fast64
    wire [7:0] group_valid;
    wire [7:0] group_select;
    wire [2:0] local_code [0:7];
    wire [7:0] code_bit0;
    wire [7:0] code_bit1;
    wire [7:0] code_bit2;

    genvar g, b;
    for (g = 0; g < 8; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        wire [7:0] x;
        wire [7:0] local_onehot;
        assign x = input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
        assign group_valid[g] = |x;

        if (g == 0) begin : bottom_group
            // Select group zero on an entirely empty input as well.
            assign group_select[g] = ~(|group_valid[7:1]);
        end else if (g == 7) begin : top_group
            assign group_select[g] = group_valid[g];
        end else begin : middle_group
            assign group_select[g] = group_valid[g] &
                                      ~(|group_valid[7:g+1]);
        end

        // Direct equations avoid a local encoded-bus mux cascade.
        assign local_code[g][2] = |x[7:4];
        assign local_code[g][1] = (|x[7:6]) |
                                      ((~(|x[7:4])) & (|x[3:2]));
        assign local_code[g][0] = x[7] |
                                      (x[5] & ~(|x[7:6])) |
                                      (x[3] & ~(|x[7:4])) |
                                      (x[1] & ~(|x[7:2]));

        // Local zero defaults to bit zero. Only the selected group matters.
        assign local_onehot[0] = ~(|x[7:1]);
        assign local_onehot[7] = x[7];
        for (b = 1; b < 7; b = b + 1) begin : local_bits
            assign local_onehot[b] = x[b] & ~(|x[7:b+1]);
        end
        assign output_unencoded[g*8 +: 8] =
            local_onehot & {8{group_select[g]}};

        assign code_bit0[g] = local_code[g][0] & group_select[g];
        assign code_bit1[g] = local_code[g][1] & group_select[g];
        assign code_bit2[g] = local_code[g][2] & group_select[g];
    end

    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign output_encoded[2:0] = {
        |code_bit2, |code_bit1, |code_bit0
    };
    assign output_encoded[5] = |group_valid[7:4];
    assign output_encoded[4] = (|group_valid[7:6]) |
        ((~(|group_valid[7:4])) & (|group_valid[3:2]));
    assign output_encoded[3] = group_valid[7] |
        (group_valid[5] & ~(|group_valid[7:6])) |
        (group_valid[3] & ~(|group_valid[7:4])) |
        (group_valid[1] & ~(|group_valid[7:2]));
end else begin : reference_parameters
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : high_first
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : low_first
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : high_first
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference propagates encoded data through a binary priority-mux tree, then decodes the resulting index into output_unencoded. This places priority selection and one-hot decoding in series on potential critical paths.",
  "rewrite": "For the fixed configuration, partition the input into eight groups of eight. Compute group validity, group priority masks, local encoded values, and local one-hot masks in parallel. Produce output_unencoded directly from the hierarchical masks instead of decoding output_encoded. Form the lower encoded bits with masked parallel reductions and the upper bits directly from group-valid priority equations. Retain the reference implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by removing the serial encode-to-decode path and replacing encoded-bus mux cascades with parallel priority equations. Actual improvement depends on SKY130HD mapping, fanout buffering, and placement; no numerical timing gain is claimed without STA.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Additional parallel priority terms trade some logic duplication for shorter paths. Group masks are shared across eight one-hot outputs and three encoded-bit terms. No state or latency is added. The 1713.518400 um2 cap and electrical compliance require mapped evaluation; they have not been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=64 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, the highest asserted input bit wins. The all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=64'b1, matching the reference default. Every nonzero input produces exactly one asserted output_unencoded bit at output_encoded. Ports, unsigned declarations, parameters, and parameter-dependent reference behavior are retained. The design is purely combinational and uses no assumptions, assertions, memories, or undefined-output substitutions."
}
